subject: Fix undefined-santitizer warning in rax test (#1122)
reason: The change only adds a (uint32_t) cast in src/unit/test_rax.c, a unit-test helper, to fix a UB-sanitizer warning in the test binary. No server, command, replication, or persistence code changes; no runtime behaviour differs between the builds, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise or compare.
